# Collateral Management Policy
1.1 Purpose
The purpose of this Collateral Management Policy is to establish the principles and requirements for managing collateral taken as security for loans and trades within the organization.

1.2 Scope
This policy applies to all employees involved in the collateral management process, including front office, middle office, and legal/compliance functions. It covers the acceptance, valuation, monitoring, and release of all forms of collateral, including but not limited to bonds, stocks, and other financial instruments.
3.1 General Principles
The organization shall take a risk-based approach to collateral management, applying appropriate discounts or haircuts to risky or volatile collateral types. All collateral accepted must meet minimum eligibility criteria and be subject to regular valuation and monitoring.

3.2 Specific Requirements
- Eligible collateral types and associated discounts shall be defined and maintained by the Collateral Desk
- Collateral valuations shall be performed daily, with more frequent monitoring for volatile assets
- Legal review is required prior to accepting any non-standard or complex collateral
3.3 Exceptions
Exceptions to this policy may be granted on a case-by-case basis with the approval of the Collateral Manager and Head of Risk. All exceptions must be documented and reported to the Risk and Compliance Committee.

4.1 Management Responsibilities
The Collateral Manager is responsible for the implementation and oversight of this policy. They shall ensure appropriate monitoring and reporting mechanisms are in place.

4.2 Staff Responsibilities
All employees involved in the collateral management process are responsible for adhering to the requirements of this policy and for escalating any issues or exceptions to the Collateral Manager.
This Collateral Management Policy follows the structure and requirements of the organization's Policy Document Template, ensuring a consistent and comprehensive approach to collateral management.
